(Currently Amended) 1. A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination, wherein the surface portion comprises at least one feature that facilitates the transfer of the cosmetic product.

(Currently Amended) 4. The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, wherein the act of depositing the first quantity facilitates the transfer of the second quantity.

(Currently Amended) 6. The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom, except for at least one feature that aids in the application or transfer of cosmetic product. 

(Currently Amended) 7. The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar, except for at least one feature that aids in the application or transfer of cosmetic product.

(Currently Amended) 11. The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, with the ring portion designed to allow for user-adjustable snugness.
